Module 1:  Agency, education and innovation (1 hour)

Position of the majority of young [sex of FGD] on the ladder of power and freedom (private rating): 5 = Power and freedom to make almost all major life decisions: 0 votes; 4 = Power and freedom to make many major life decisions: 2 votes; 3 = Power and freedom to make some major life decisions: 5 votes; 2 = Only a small amount of power and freedom: 3 votes; 1 = Almost no power or freedom to make decisions: 0 votes

we have some fear of speaking out what we think and revealing our decisions because we still live with our parents if they say no and are angry we do not have anywhere to og. So I believe we are at stage 2.

I believe we are at stage 3 because previously our parents mainly our fathers decide who we should be married to. These days even if they try I will resist and no one will be forcing me to marry. But in other matters may be we are not adequately deciding for ourselves. But I say the situation has improved and deciding on marriage issues are very important for me.

I feel we are at three because we can decide if we are involved in small businesses and they would not interfere as long as we have the means. We also decide on matters of marriage. However in relation o mobility still the boys are more mobile and have opportunities to decide on such things.

We have no opportunity as girls to get training on for example income generation and the like. We have never been invited during any important events. No one remembers us. I got surprised even this time when we were asked to come to this meeting. It is not that we are not interested but [how do you think this relates to your level of decisions?] It is related, we need exposure we need to know what to do with our lives and what to think about. We have no information so even if we want to decide there is nothing to base your decision on.
I believe yes we can decide on few things. But since we live with them we cannot decide on everything.
it is good to be educated. It will help us reach far, it helps achieve our vision. It will give us job and we will become more successful in what we do.

There is no discrimination in our area; if they go to school they can reach as far. However, many drop out early because of different challenges including lack of interest and commitment to their studies. And as a result most reach grade 10 and that is it. They fail national exam and that is it.

It is the same as we said earlier. There is no as such difference between boys and girls. Boys even in some cases may withdraw school to become shepherds and support the family. They may also migrate to tows in search of work. Anyways, most girls also stop at grad 10 because they cannot pass the matriculation at that level.

Many mothers wish to send their daughter to school. Actually they send both girs and boys. They send their girls to school hoping that they will be able to become some people are manage to have better life in towns. For girls it is not easy to focus because we are always going to school half hearted. We would like to learn bit also would also like to go outside of the country and send remittance to our family.

As for me. I never plan or want to go outside of the country. I decided to continue my education here. I reached grade 10 and then I did not pass the exam. So I am no longer able to join further education so I am stuck now. This makes people cut hope in education. I noticed that a friend of mine who went to an XX and she brought back some money. Everybody respects her better than me and sometimes this makes me angry.

We do everything we also learn how to prepare the land, we support our parents in the farming, Since we were small kids, we go out in the farm, we do the winnowing, weeding, milking, taking care of the chicken, etc. so we have learnt a lot

When I was a kid, I have been a shepherd for seven years. I also have helped in weeding, and harvesting, we also pile up straw etc. I also learned how to take care of livestock. But now, I for me, I do help them in the household; I never help in the field. They would not ask these days. And for boys, they have also become difficult and they are not interested in helping. They will not help at all. They will prefer to go to towns and work and comeback. Our families are left in the field, we are not working I n the field. Boys have lost interest in agriculture. They know it means a lot of tough work.

Reasons for ending education
• Shortage of money to continue education we prefer to go to outside of the country get money and send back home.
• illness
• Lack of knowledge
• Lose of parents
• Destructive or risky behaviors (they may go to their boyfriends on the way)
• [Abduction?] No there is none these days. The girl may abduct the boy the boy have stopped abducting girls)
• Teachers are so late when the students are there they will be absent that makes students loose interest.
• Divorce
• Lower grades
• Lack of interest

Two most important reasons
• Shortage of money forcing girls to go outside of the country and send back money
• Lower grades

Money problem is major problem I believe. If the family has shortage of money, their livelihood is in question and a s a result, we tend to focus on how to get some shortcut to bring out the family out of this misery. So the easiest way has been traveling to other countries to bring back money. And for me this is the reason why we are having lower grades among other things.

I think there are many other reasons girls have bad grades, but it is defiantly the reason for her stopping her education. As they know they get lower grade they will lost interest. And their friends and parents also will say things which make them lose hope. I feel there are many girls at home who have stopped learning because she knows that at the end of the day she will fall 10th grade. So may stop even earlier.

when I was a kid I used to hope to become a teacher . One of my teacher hit me on my finger and I was very sick for a while and I used to hope to be a teacher and hit other children like he does to me. Now I realized how wrong I have been. Anyways, I preferred to be a teacher because they play key role in changing other’s lives for the better. So I wanted to influence kid’s life. But I was not able to pass 10th grade. And I am not sure if I manage to take the exam again.
Have no goal
teacher
no plan
Teacher,
I used to hope to get to TTI (teacher’s training institute)
Medical doctor

I am the 8th kid in my family. My mother was operated when she gave me birth, and my father told me about it and he hoped for me to be a medical doctor and operate on others and save their lives. So I wanted to become a doctor to do same operation and save mother’s lives.
Accountant
When girls are no longer students they are hired as daily laborer in nearby towns. They also go to other country to bring money back to the family or migrate to towns and work in bars.

In my opinion there is nothing as such, there is always a chance to study further. However, in places like ours when a girls stops studying she has to be able to become productive through opening up business, or engaging in some productive endeavors she should not sit still and wait for others to be responsible for her.

If it was in the past I could have said she should get married. I would not now, This is because, the boy we would marry is also uneducated and has nothing. So it is very hard to live with him. So I prefer o say she has to be able to work.

Most important for the [sex of the FGD] of the community (top 2)
• Row planting
• Terracing

Most important for the [opposite sex of FGD] of the community (top 2)
• Row planting and
• Fattening
Row planting is important for women because if they manage to do it they will get better yield and productivity increases, then income increases. That we believe is important for her.

Terracing is also very important for the women because the soil and the water would be protected for her to involve in vegetable gardening and make it sustainable due to its contribution to prevent soil degradation and also contributes to the weather also. If she has vegetable garden, she will be self sufficient during the year.

The boys benefit most than the girls. Because as we mentioned it earlier, no one asks us to come and participate in such things. If we ask our family if they can give us some start up money, they would hesitate but if it is for the boys they prefer to do give it to their boys, Boys are given also and other materials when they ask but for the girls it does not happen most often.
We have never tired before, we are afraid we may lose. We do not know each other that well so we are afraid of working together.

I was just thinking about why parents hesitate to give resource to their girls and reflect on that. I believe that they know that if they give her resource she is capable of working with it. But once she is married all their property and what she worked for so far will be taken by the man. So it is a loss anyways.

Important crops or livestock for [sex of FGD] Ten years ago

Technology has improved, they are learning new ways of cultivating lands. Women are more active these days. And are working harder.

Not that much. For instance some years ago, maize was exclusively grown by the women in the home garden. It was not considered important by men. These days it may not be grown widely but men are more and more controlling it. Anyways, the young may not be following for different reasons. I feel they are not interested in agriculture. They prefer to work as laborer or migrate to towns. Additionally, they may not have land as it is only possible to get it from their family. Especially those whose family do not afford to pass land to them once they are married that would be difficult for them. There is no much opportunity.
No I do not think so we know what our rights are. The girls will not allow this to happen.
She has to be informed and they need to decide together, otherwise, she will never agree so they will destroy their marriage.
She cannot sell in bulk she is allowed to sale small amounts to buy back household consumptions items.

There is no as such proper division of plots between him and her. The bigger plot is always his and she will be managing often the smaller plot which is the vegetable garden. On the big plot of land she supports him farming. Her rile is supporting. There is no negotiation or discussion on the land regarding where who works. It is a given. [why is she considered supporter while she participates equally in the farming?]

if the vegetable garden is larger, he will help her with preparing the land the rest would be her work. For the major plot where they grow crop they work together. He will not help if he is not sure whether the vegetables would make him profitable.

mothers always work on the husband’s plot. She has to support. She is expected to work. Especially if he is practicing row planting there is no way she can escape. Actually even before this practice came she would be working with him, She is also responsible for the household works also. They do everything together in his land. But when it comes to vegetable gardens he has to choice.
If the land for the vegetables is small, he would say if you want do the gardening or not you can leave it do not expect me to labor on something that is not worth it.

Sometimes boys help on their mother’s plot there are boys who are not willing to support their mothers and never works. The boys are more obedient for the father. The man is capable of forcing his boys to work. They think that what their father’s are telling them is what is important for their life. Generally speaking, women are not supported in the household.
Most work on their father’s land, some girls do support their mothers while others are not.

Not all of their children are disobedient; some of them would support her in the work. When it is a mother led house, the young boy often take over the role of the father and may try to boss her around. And he will take over the farm also.

She will consult her husband or her son. She will never do anything by herself because he knows the condition of the soil. He is more knowledgeable about farming. [And what about the man?] He will also consult his wife. Even if she does not know much he needs to inform her. [why does he need to consult her if she does not know the soil type?]. Just because she has to know.
I believe such consultation is happening in few houses. These are also some men who are not consulting. They assume that the woman do not know anything so they decide by themselves.
he would not allow her to join the association because he wants her to be at home.
Once she has given all her rights up from the start. She would never ask him why and therefore, this is something she will ever be able to decide on. She has to abide by his decision.

she may try to convince him. If she does it without his consent their marriage would be in trouble. But the probability is that he would say no. [What if she insisted?] he would tell her to abandon her idea or leave the house.
he may even say that as long as I control your income and benefit from becoming the member of association you can join the association.
(laughing) that is the end of their marriage. He would never allow that. If he does he knows that she will become more independent and that is the end of everything.
Again I believe, if she convinces him that is possible. But it is difficult to convince him.

Never. She cannot even ask that. He would automatically send her off. Their marriage will be over so to sell it she has to move out and go to court, I believe, there is no need to even engage him on this.
if they are the kind of people who respect each other, then he may say that. He may think that this is too much for her.
If he is educated and well mannered he may say that.
Oh. We have to know that majority of the people here are not like that. Most of them would want the woman to work until the end of the day and even during the night.
she will be referred as the one who has put her husband under her feet.
Isn’t she ashamed? To leave her husband at home and stay out? She should be truly ashamed.
they will say she is dominating him and influencing him badly. He will defiantly lose respect from his family and also friends.
You are like a woman. You are staying home and taking care of the children? Unthinkable! Why?
He would never be trusted and selected for major responsibilities such as Shimglina (ad hoc council of elders coming together to deal with marriage, or conflict issues)
His fiends will tell him not to go out of the house, “remain in the house; you are no longer a man…”
You were supposed to be a man; but you are no longer one. “give your trouser to her you no longer need it, go change and dress up in skirts…”

woman will try to tell him to act and become a man. He should not work at home, he should go out. They will not abandon him right away, but they will force him to act normal. To be a man. And later they may leave him. [His parents?]
They will hate him, and her also for making him become like this. she will be made responsible for his supposed failure as a man.
P.4They will tell him to divorce her immediately. They will order him to be a man or forget his relations with him.
He will be happy and he will support her more.

Since he has done this from the start and he knows that she may become successful he would not say anything but continue to support her, and when the children grow he may find something to work on or ask to work with her.
Gender equality is to have equal rights when it comes to work, benefit, education, speaking, to be listened, to move around, to engage in business, organize and decide .
Previously they used to make us marry without our consent. They used to decide who we marry and when. Now we can decide not to get married.
They all agreed that it is good
It is good thing because it will help both girls and boys to work together and achieve better.
Both of them cannot decide by themselves on anything. They have to sit together and discuss and decide together.
They may consult together but he makes the final decision.

Actually if whatever has to be sold is small, she can do the decision but if it is in bulk she cannot do it. It is his role to do the selling in larger amounts. [what will he do with the money? Would he bring and give the money to her?] it depends, yes there are some who does that. But others may even not tell her how much they have sold and may not even bring it back home.

If he has other mistress that is difficult because he may hide the money. If not he would bring the money home, in some cases, when these things happen their own young boy may steal form the house and try to fled to other towns with the money.
If he wants he may spend it with friends. Any ways, she will also sale without his knowledge if she needs the money for something.
Since it is a new thing he may agree. He may think that this will bring more money to the household so he would say yes.

No I do not think so. He has to see first. He has to understand how others have benefited from the same thing. He will try to learn from others. So I say he would not give her that chance that easily.
it is difficult because she has to get his consent. She will never do it.

She will lobby him as long as it takes. If he insisted she will send Shimagle (ad hoc council of elders) to convince him. The “shimagle” will also support her because what she is saying is right. I.e. she is saying that we need to invest the money on something that would be profitable.

whatever, she cannot and if she pushed her own idea and decided by her own then that is the end of the marriage. He would say who is the head of this household? If you are; go ahead and leave…In any case they have to agree. So it is difficult
All agreed that It is neither easy nor difficult (3) for him.

It is easy because he can take decisions by himself on such big issues. The money is his own and therefore he can buy, but when he brings it home she will never be happy and that will create tension in the house.
It is his right. If he wants he can even ask her to leave the house. She cannot force him to leave when he decide by himself but if she does, she will leave the house.
She may say no. However, he would say “how dare you say no! this is my money and I can do anything with it”. Eventually he will do what he pleased.
she can go freely on market days and hours. The only thing is she should be careful to return home on time.

She will run back to her house because she also has a lot of things waiting to be done by her so she has no rest until she has accomplished the household chores. As a result she will rush back home. Otherwise, there is no problem for a girl to go round lone.
the culture will not allow them to move freely. The time of the day that they can move freely is limited.
I do not agree, if she is not afraid of hyenas she can stay out as much as she pleased.
]She may be the one who will abduct him these days, there is no problem.

it is more difficult for married woman to move around and be late from coming home on time before the husband returns. Otherwise, there is no danger as such on the road. Occasionally women may get raped, or may get harassed but not that much.
No it is not difficult. Because it is common thing to see women involved in trade in the local market.

In some cases marriage starts at 14. These days it is common at 19. Anyways, whoever above 18 is getting married.

Previously, it was the family who will decide for her. She will be told to marry whoever her father chose for her. She will never be consulted. She has no say on that issue, but these days it is consent between the boy and the girl. The family has stopped interfering.
even if that is the case, even today if the father orders the girl is likely to say ok.
based on consent [all talked at once, and later agreed]

19 is good. As said earlier she is fit to take care of her baby. (all talked together for a little while, they decided that is right),

we would like to have training. Almost a year ago, some health professionals came here and gathered us and gave us training for 15 days on health issues. It was so helpful and very applicable in our live. We need that kind of trainings to come to us.
We would like to have opportunities to work. If the kebele can organize us into groups and provide us with the space and initial capital that would be very good.
